text_block_list.text:
The Fan Fest—a festival held to
celebrate the
fans who regularly support
our racers.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The athletic competitions are the
highlight of the
Spring Fan Fest...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! This is so exciting! The
2,000-meter dirt
race is next!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
...In other words, it's your turn to
compete! Get a
move on!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Huh?! No way! I'm in the middle of a
date with my
trainer!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Not you too, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Hmph... You're such a meanie. Ruining
my date
like that...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
...Seriously? We might be at a festival
today, but
aren't you gettin' a bit too
carried away?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Have you already forgotten? Look
around.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: And take note.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Of what?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. I'll show you what I've got.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Heh... Don't get too cocky.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
Whoa, everyone's looking at me! ☆
Oooh, guess
I'm stealing all the
attention! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: ...Well?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
...I've never raced against most of these
racers
before.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Exactly. This is quite a rare lineup.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
It's true that this race is just for fun, but
that's
exactly why...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
You can face off against opponents you
normally
wouldn't.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
This race is your one and only chance to
take on
this lineup.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
So just this once... go out there and have
as much
fun as possible.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: ...As much fun as possible?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Precisely. This race will also help you
grow! So—
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Grow?! Into an adult?!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Copy that! ☆ Today, I'll soar right past
even you,
Hishiama!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Huh?! Don't get too carried away!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Soon after, the 2,000-meter dirt race
begins...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Argh... Trainer...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Mayano! Looks like ya had a
crash
landing.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Still, this is a good opportunity for you.
Sear the
faces of the winners into your
mind and use the
frustration you feel as
a springboard.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: That's how I got to where I am. Heh.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Mmph... I have to get better... I have to
grow!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Woohoo! Falco!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text: Urgh! No, no, no! I hate this!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: I wanna hear Trainer praise me like that!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Sigh... You really are obsessed with your trainer, huh?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Hmph... I wanted to show Trainer that
I've grown
up.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
choice_data_list: I can already feel that you have.

text_block_list.text: Trainer...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Argh! I'm gonna go run in another race!
And I'm
totally gonna win this time!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I already told ya that you can only run
once!
Unbelievable!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Traaaainer! I got first! ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Keep the praise coming! ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
...What a fearsome sight. To think you
would beat
not just me but everyone in
that race...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Heehee! Thanks for encouraging me to
race,
Hishiama!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: It was super fun! And so... exciting too!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I thought about all the things I could
only do in
that race, and a bunch of
strategies popped into
my head!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I tried all the most exciting running
styles I could
think of.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: You came up with all that on the fly?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
You really are gonna be a thorn in my
side!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Today, I really felt like I could see
Mayano Top
Gun's growth with my own
two eyes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон and I run off to stop the
manic
Mayano Top Gun.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
